title: Ricochet Grid
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small single-pass 180-second stereo master; a continuous 128-second excerpt from 32s forms the station mix and its first 64 seconds form the game mix; -8.5 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Create one original 180-second stereo melodic drum and bass instrumental at strict 174 BPM in 4/4 for a family-friendly one-or-two-key rhythm game. By 24 seconds the full two-step dance groove plays continuously: punchy kick, dry backbeat snare, crisp shuffled hats, warm rolling bass, bright chord accents and a separate short pitched lead attack each quarter beat. Signature hook: four quick alternating notes rebound into a rising two-note answer; vary the answer, bass roots and fills after 96 seconds. Keep 32-to-160 seconds strong and even with no sparse breakdown or fade. Clean playful energy, clear beat accents, original melodic contour. No vocals, speech, samples, harsh clipping, tempo drift or imitation.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original high-contrast comic-print cover: one coral ricochet line zigzags across an offset ivory/cyan rhythm grid, four sharp rebound nodes, no score UI, text or character.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Wide duohertz title card with ricochet rhythm grid on right and Ricochet Grid on left.
art_provenance.render_method: local macOS sips SVG-to-PNG; source raster equality checked before staging
art_provenance.cover_svg: Local SVG title overlay around the authored cover-art.png
